info.title: LightNVR API — Streams, identity and recording reads
info.description: Partial contract for the current C backend. It covers Streams list/full/update, authenticated discovery, login/config/verify/logout, safe client configuration, scoped-token lifecycle, and UI recording reads/timeline/playback/thumbnail routes. User administration, legacy-key issuance, TOTP completion/enrollment, session/trusted-device management, other bootstrap routes, other media protocols and unrelated UI calls remain unspecified. Recording export/download/protection/deletion and jobs remain a later slice. Absence from this document is not evidence of denied access to an unspecified API. Visibility describes current usable authority; every actual request still enforces authorization. A valid session takes precedence over Basic, then X-API-Key/Bearer credentials; use a cookie-free client to inspect a scoped token. CIDR and required-password-change restrictions retain their existing semantics; independent API keys/tokens are exempt from the password-change gate. Existing non-discovery APIs retain auth-disabled/demo deployment behavior. This document contains no deployment-derived examples or credentials.

x-lightnvr-coverage.description: Partial contract coverage: Streams pilot, identity/token, recording reads and twelve recording action/job operations. The covered operation list is independent of authorization; omitted projected operations may be covered but denied. Uncovered APIs are not permission decisions. Identity includes session/trusted-device lifecycle, MFA completion/enrollment, password change and legacy logout. F3 adds user administration, role/policy management, action simulation and audit events/settings/CSV; all direct targets remain independently authorized. F11 adds investigations/bookmarks, detections/models, LPR and remaining recording media/file protocols; binary and redirect responses have explicit media contracts.

Local416 currently omits Content-Range; archive416 supplies bytes */size. Existing parser is permissive: bytes=0 (missing dash) becomes full206 and multi-ranges are treated as their first numeric range, not multipart. Do not infer strict RFC rejection of malformed ranges.

OpenApiDocument.description: A valid OpenAPI 3.1.1 document projected for the actual authenticated principal. This response schema checks its envelope; independent OpenAPI lint checks document validity. It can contain no camera-specific eligible operations while retaining authenticated discovery/list operations.

totp_code.description: Optional inline MFA code; enrollment and challenge completion endpoints remain outside this slice.

LoginRequest.description: JSON credentials. The C handler copies username/password into 64-byte buffers (63-byte payload); it does not reject oversized strings before truncating. totp_token.description: Ephemeral MFA challenge credential. Returned only by login; never an ordinary identity/token-list field or documentation example.

AuthVerifyResponse.description: Real credential identity, auth-disabled synthetic admin, or unauthenticated demo viewer. Synthetic modes do not authorize personalized discovery.

ClientConfig.description: Safe browser playback configuration only. Deliberately closed shape: no storage paths, integrations, private settings or credentials. go2rtc_available may stay true while its lifecycle guard is busy.

TokenSelector.description: Existing fleet selector grammar. Server additionally enforces depth≤8, total nodes≤64, UTF-8 byte limits and serialized selector<8192 bytes. Evaluation and delegation containment remain server decisions.

ApiTokenScope.description: All, selector or collection camera scope. Inapplicable selector/collection fields may be absent or null. A narrow owner cannot delegate all scope simply because current matches happen to be identical.

description.description: Trimmed by server; must contain non-whitespace text, no control characters, and fewer than128 UTF-8 bytes.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds strictly after server time and at most366 days ahead.

actions.description: Duplicates collapse into an action mask.

ApiTokenCreateRequest.description: Requested action and camera scope must be contained in BOTH token owner and requester authority. At most256 active tokens per owner. Additional request keys do not rewrite user policy.

ApiTokenMetadata.description: Non-secret token record; prefix is an identifier, never a reusable credential. Secret/hash fields are explicitly forbidden.

ApiTokenList.description: Lists token metadata, including revoked/expired records. Secret is never returned.

secret.description: One-time bearer secret; store securely after creation. Ordinary token-list/identity responses never include it.

ApiTokenCreated.description: Only successful token creation returns a secret. No secret value is included in examples.

RecordingDetail.description: Authorized recording metadata. id is durable database identity, not list position. Times are UTC display strings with separate Unix seconds. In-progress rows have null end_time/end_time_unix and changing effective duration. playback_issue is empty for no saved issue; invalid_media/no_video/decode_error cause playback422. Other diagnostic values do not conclusively prohibit playback. Optional storage fields are omitted if their lookup fails. file_path is existing authorized metadata, not a client-selected playback path. A finalized row or timeline presence does not guarantee playable media.

RecordingPagination.description: Counts use the same authorized predicate as rows. Ordinary totals may use a ten-second cache invalidated by supported database mutations; limit=all recounts and resets page1. No top-level total is emitted. When replay scope is empty, the early empty envelope retains the normalized requested page and ordinary limit (all is treated as20).

RecordingTimelineSegment.description: Timeline timestamps are Unix seconds; display strings use server local YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. local_* fields currently equal the Unix timestamp fields. In-progress segments use an effective end for display. Timeline segments omit playback_issue and protected/storage metadata: use detail/playback before treating a finalized segment as playable.

RecordingTimeline.description: One authorized camera and time window, capped at8640 segments. Optional exact external-motion intervals may be absent on allocation failure.

RecordingTimelineByIds.description: Requested IDs are processed in request order. Missing, deleted-camera and denied recordings are omitted. Counts and overall range reflect retained segments only; an empty result has empty start_time/end_time. Duplicate input IDs can produce duplicate segments.

RecordingRetentionRequest.description: Numeric input is truncated toward zero through the C JSON integer accessor. Any negative value clears the override; zero means indefinite; positive values are days.

RecordingBatchProtectionRequest.description: Empty arrays are accepted. Invalid or missing IDs count as failures; an existing forbidden member rejects the entire request before writes.

RecordingTagsRequest.description: Only nonempty string elements are used; other elements are ignored. The database trims tag text, truncates to its fixed UTF-8 byte buffer, and deduplicates. This is replacement, including clearing with an empty array.

RecordingBatchTagsRequest.description: Add/remove are optional; wrong-typed arrays and non-string or empty elements are ignored by the handler. All IDs are authorized before writes. Database failures may follow earlier successful tag writes.

recordings_count.description: Number of authorized input IDs processed, including duplicate IDs.

tags_added.description: Successful per-recording add statement executions, including INSERT OR IGNORE no-ops; not changed rows.

tags_removed.description: Successful per-recording remove statement executions, including absent-tag no-ops; not changed rows.

RecordingDeletionResult.description: Immediate200 has success/message. Queued202 also carries status deletion_pending; neither outcome promises deletion of unrelated recordings.

RecordingDeletionFilter.description: stream_name (or stream fallback) selects comma-separated current camera names. Without a nonempty stream filter, all-fleet recording.delete authority is required. Authorized camera UUIDs and collection membership are captured before dispatch; caller-supplied camera UUID fields do not grant scope. start/end are UTC timestamp strings. detection/protected numeric values use C integer conversion; protected is clamped to -1..1. In-progress rows are excluded.

anyOf.description: IDs take precedence over filter. Invalid or missing members become failed counts; a forbidden existing member rejects the whole request before job creation.

ids.description: Array-valued ids take precedence over filter and must be nonempty. Other ids values fall through to the filter handler.

RecordingDeletionProgress.description: complete is true for both complete and error terminal states. A complete job can have failed members or queued pending deletions; it does not imply every file is already removed. SQL failure is error; an empty successful filter completes with zero counts. No cancellation endpoint/state exists.

RecordingExportRequest.description: Positive numeric IDs are converted to uint64. Filename is sanitized for attachment delivery. Every member is authorized before a job is created; existing operational missing/incomplete errors can abort earlier in input order.

RecordingExportStatus.description: error is always present, usually empty until failure. Detected unavailable sources or ZIP32 member/size-limit failures put the job in error and remove its temporary result. The current writer does not consistently check filesystem read/write/close errors: complete is not a guarantee against undetected I/O failure or a valid intact archive. No cancellation endpoint/state exists.

PasswordChangeRequest.description: New password must contain at least eight UTF-8 bytes. Self-service requires the current password; effective users.manage can reset passwords except its own forced first-login change. Locked/default-password rules are enforced by the server.

FleetQueryRequest.description: Read-only POST. Defaults: all selector, page 1, page_size 50, name/asc, facets true, explain false, availability all. Server enforces UTF-8 byte length for search and bounded selector parsing; an invalid or stale selector never grants visibility.

FleetPreviewRequest.description: Read-only POST. Defaults: all selector, page 1, page_size 50, name/asc, facets true, explain false, availability all. Server enforces UTF-8 byte length for search and bounded selector parsing; an invalid or stale selector never grants visibility.

EvidenceRangeRequest.description: End must exceed start by no more than 31 days. All explicit cameras must exist and permit recordings.replay; mixed unauthorized input is rejected.

EvidenceBookmarkCreate.description: Camera list, primary camera, region and saved result must agree. Cursor must lie inside the interval. The bookmark is owned by the current user (also for scoped tokens), never grants access, and does not protect media from retention.

EvidenceLprSearchRequest.description: Epoch milliseconds, end at/after start within 366 days; match requires a canonicalizable plate (partial at least 3 canonical characters). Search returns at most 100 rows.
